recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-27145 source work remains; future broad edits to the version-management tables should continue to be handled under their own later trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-27145 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I clarification for R5. It reported that http.html#version-parameter still described FHIR R4 as not yet published even though R4 had already been published, and the approved resolution was to update the current build so the stale status would not persist into future publications.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-27145 was found. Historical source from 2020 still had the R4 row as "4.0 (once published)" after the Jira vote, but later version-table maintenance removed that stale status: FHIR-31715-era commits added R4B/R5 rows and changed the R4 row to "4.0", and later FHIR-35172 reconciliation clarified the labels across the active version tables.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists source/http.html, source/versioning.html, and source/versions.html as active build pages. The Zulip thread linked from Jira confirms the original bug report, and FHIR-I minutes record the 2020-08-31 11-0-0 Persuasive with Mod vote to update the current build.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source and combined branch already satisfy FHIR-27145, and searches of the relevant active pages found no remaining stale R4 publication-status wording.
